findings.title: Assert the changed exit-code contract
findings.body: This PR changes incompatible checks from exit code 4 to 3 and assigns 4 to disabled-feature failures, but the new disabled-feature test and the incompatible-version tests do not assert those exact codes. The guide explicitly tells automation to rely on exit codes rather than messages, so retaining the old incompatible code or returning a generic error for a disabled feature could break callers without failing these tests. Assert exit code 4 for disabled metadata and check commands, and exit code 3 for incompatible checks.
